cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First day in accounts, and I've reconciled this invoice. It's in the right drawer; you may check it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's filing. Reconciliation means matching it to our records.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Filed, then. Bring me this quote and I'll reconcile the invoice against it. You can watch how I handle the matching.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an estimate. You need the purchase order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Estimate filed; purchase order next. Bring that to me and we'll reconcile properly. I like our accounts terminology precise; keep correcting the labels before they reach my final check.

reason: Reread found reconcile it after quote could lose the invoice referent. Explicitly match the invoice against the proposed document, preserving B correction to purchase order and A adopted terminology.
